Use case: precise-object-edit.
Chinese app 同拍 ONEBEAT PRO 定制鼓机, high fidelity UI design, NOT wireframe. Reference 1 is the accepted Scheme A page, reference 2 is style popover closeup, reference 3 is frequency popover closeup. Preserve Scheme A's arrangement structure and established palette. The latest textual instructions override any conflicting details in reference images.
Shared STRICT new design specification:
- Outer section cards and popover shells: corner radius 8vp. Inner controls, option tiles and saved square cards' inner elements: corner radius 6vp. Keep corners small and crisp, not giant pill corners.
- ALL shadows are SOLID opaque near-black shapes translated +4vp right and +4vp down with ZERO blur radius, ZERO feathering, ZERO translucency, ZERO gradient/fading. Like a printed comic ink offset slab. No gray glow, no ambient studio shadows. Shapes and borders remain crisp. Flat fills without gradients or faux paper clouds.
- Popovers keep warm white outer shell, black outline and a small integrated triangular pointer anchored to the field. NO "只修改这一段" footer: remove that text AND the empty footer/divider area entirely.
- STYLE menu ONLY: unselected options are full pastel colored rectangles, NO outline on any option tile, dark text; SELECTED 摇滚 is coral #FF7056 with WHITE text and WHITE ✓. No tiny colored dots. Grid two columns. Existing style names/colors.
- OTHER three menus: all unselected options use pure WHITE #FFFFFF fill, black text, NO border/outlines on individual options; selected option coral #FF7056 with WHITE text and WHITE ✓. No multicolored unselected options, no colored dots. Use clean spacing to separate white rows. No lines around rows. Menu shell still has black outline.
- Pattern and fill form rows have ONLY two standalone icons at right: solid black play triangle and clean black pencil/edit icon, no written labels "试听" or "编辑", no lilac button rectangles behind icons, no extra circular containers. Draw icons directly on card surface, aligned with field. They remain visually separate from dropdown chevrons. Full-song bottom "试听整曲" text is retained; icon-only rule applies to per-row actions.
- Form body keeps EXACT FOUR rows in EXACT order: 节奏型 / 重复 / 加花 / 频率.
- Saved arrangements "我的编排" become compact SQUARE cards in a horizontal scroll row. Each card has equal width and height, concise title, meter, at most TWO style names/chips, then a literal "…" when there are 3 or more. Never show the third style or list all styles in the square card. Show two full square cards and a clipped portion of third at right to communicate horizontal scroll. NO album/video cover photos, NO large waveform thumbnails. Preserve small delete × and a compact 载入 action.
Global palette page warm ivory #FFF9EE, shell white/cream, ink #171B1F, primary coral #FF7056, secondary lilac #C5B7EB. Restrained coral/lilac halftone accents at page edges. Typography bold clear Chinese, no characters or props.

Edit reference 1 into the refined Scheme A main page. Output ONE polished portrait app page at high resolution, ideally 1024x1664, not a comparison collage. Small sheet caption above viewport "方案 A · 细节调整版". No bulky phone hardware. Keep page legible and complete.
Show DEFAULT CLOSED dropdowns in this main page so all form icons and saved cards are unobscured. The separate detail sheet will show open popovers. Do not render a floating dropdown on this main page.
Header retains back chevron, 定制鼓机, small PRO, coral 保存. Shared 拍号 4/4 and BPM –120+ remain. 编排 summary "3种风格 · 3/8段".
Section A expanded. Its header has coral 段落 A tab, collapse caret next to title, coral style selector "摇滚 ⌄", delete × at extreme right. Four rows:

Give pattern/fill dropdowns the extra width reclaimed from removing word buttons. All icon rows aligned.
Sections B and C remain collapsed one-line cards, labels 段落 B / 爵士 / 4小节 and 段落 C / 放克 / 4小节 respectively. Yellow and light blue header tabs consistent with original. Black sharp offset shadows under each.
Then full-width lilac "+ 新增段落"; bottom action row white "▶ 试听整曲" and coral "应用到队伍 ›".
Redesign lower 我的编排 area: header 我的编排 left and "3个编排" right. Underneath a horizontally scrolling row of actual SQUARE cards with widths equal to heights, around112vp. Show TWO WHOLE squares plus half of a THIRD to the right, never a long landscape list card. First square title "混合律动", meter "4/4", only two small style badges "摇滚" and "爵士" followed by "…"; the saved arrangement is multi-style but DO NOT show 放克 on first card. Tiny delete × at top-right and small 载入 action. Second square "起步摇滚", "4/4", one badge "摇滚", small 载入 and ×. Third partially clipped card "夜行律动", meter4/4, badges 放克/嘻哈 if visible. These are brief text cards, not photos. Ensure square geometry is obvious and row clipped to viewport, with a slim horizontal scroll cue if desired.
Preserve familiar Scheme A feel; don't redesign into a timeline, sections still vertically stacked. Do not add new feature copy, tooltips or footer. ALL shadows hard black offset with NO blur as explicitly required.
